name: ConsumerReplenishment - Default (seed v1)
description: A consumer's replenishment setting (town logistics P9, #127, TOWN_LOGISTICS § 3): min and max of one blueprint in one Input or Merchandise storage of a structure, and an optional priority class. When stock (with what is on the way) falls to the min, the planner reserves up to the max at a warehouse and the consumer's own worker collects it. Without a setting the policy's Replenishment rules apply, then the structure's line inputs (game setting production.logistics).

steps.description: The storage, the blueprint and its min and max.

fields.label: Consumer storage
fields.description: An Input or Merchandise storage of a structure (not a warehouse).

fields.label: Min (reorder point)
fields.description: Reserve when stock falls to this.

fields.label: Max (target level)
fields.description: Reserve up to this (at least the min, above 0).

fields.label: Priority class
fields.description: Under scarcity, higher classes are served first; empty = the policy's priority rules (Normal without one).

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the planner ignores this setting.
